base_prompt: Edit the approved packaging concept in reference1 with geometry reference2 authoritative. Create ONE empty packaging pouch in almost straight-on three-quarter product studio view, only slight side visible, no text, no collage. Keep raised storage chamber top and orange ZIPPER ON UPWARD FACING TOP GUSSET, NOT across vertical front. Rear panel continuous capsule silhouette with integral punched hole near upper center, no projecting tab. Exact outline of white capsule in reference2, width/height=1.40, short straight top/bottom and semicircular sides, not rounded rectangle. MAIN CHANGE: FRONT PANEL optically clear transparent smooth firm resilient plastic, the side gussets, rear sheet, top and bottom all semi-transparent frosted milky satin material. Orange narrow curved parentheses printed on front sides. Neutral colorless reinforced seam, NO orange outer perimeter. Standing empty with about 8cm depth, flat short base, no crumpled film, no glass box. Clear front allows later merchandise full visibility; frosted rear creates softly diffused neutral background. Light warm white studio backdrop, soft grounded shadow, 4:3 landscape, no typography, no products, no extra design. Visually preserve approved full shape and hole and top-loading mechanism. Show zipper closed along top with its slider subtly visible at right.
